Per Sandeep Kohli's note: Dabhol Phase I tariff is Rs. 4.02/kWh at 90% despatch, falling to Rs. 3.30-3.70/kWh with Phase II (1440 MW, due end-2001); MSEB is 45-60 days late on payments; outflows up to Rs. 450 Cr./month vs MSEB collections ~Rs. 900 Cr./month.

Sandeep Kohli proposed Dabhol fixes: absorb Phase II power across the Western Region grid (42000 MW) and interconnects, restructure guarantees, add central entities (IOC/GAIL) to equity, back-end tariffs. He also gave a Mumbai presentation on power-trading roadblocks.
